name: Snowflake MCP
description: Pass-through to a Snowflake Cortex Agents MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP). Server-agnostic: configure the base URL and MCP server path, authenticate per-user via Snowflake OAuth, then call any tool the upstream server exposes.
author: AI Playground

snowflakeBaseUrl.title: Snowflake Account URL
snowflakeBaseUrl.description: Base URL of your Snowflake account, e.g. https://xy12345.snowflakecomputing.com

mcpServerPath.title: MCP Server Path
mcpServerPath.description: Path of the managed MCP server, e.g. /api/v2/databases/MY_DB/schemas/MY_SCHEMA/mcp-servers/MY_MCP

oauthClientId.title: OAuth Client ID
oauthClientId.description: Client ID of the Snowflake security integration. Falls back to SNOWFLAKE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID env var.

oauthClientSecret.title: OAuth Client Secret
oauthClientSecret.description: Client secret of the Snowflake security integration. Falls back to SNOWFLAKE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET env var.

oauthScope.title: OAuth Scope
oauthScope.description: OAuth scope. Default: 'session:role-any refresh_token'. Use 'session:role:<ROLE>' to pin a specific role.

timeoutSeconds.title: Request Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time for a tool call to the upstream MCP server.

tools.name: List Snowflake MCP tools
tools.description: List the tools exposed by the configured Snowflake MCP server (JSON-RPC tools/list).

systemPromptInstructions.fr:
- snowflake_list_tools: Liste les outils disponibles sur le serveur Snowflake MCP configuré
  - Utilise-le AVANT d'appeler snowflake_call_tool pour découvrir les outils disponibles et leur schéma d'entrée
  - Retourne un tableau d'outils avec leur nom, description et inputSchema (JSON Schema)
systemPromptInstructions.en:
- snowflake_list_tools: Lists the tools available on the configured Snowflake MCP server
  - Use it BEFORE calling snowflake_call_tool to discover available tools and their input schemas
  - Returns an array of tools with name, description, and inputSchema (JSON Schema)

tools.name: Call Snowflake MCP tool
tools.description: Invoke a tool on the configured Snowflake MCP server (JSON-RPC tools/call).

systemPromptInstructions.fr:
- snowflake_call_tool: Appelle un outil du serveur Snowflake MCP
  - Paramètres: { name: string, arguments: object }
  - Le nom doit correspondre à un outil retourné par snowflake_list_tools
  - Les arguments doivent respecter l'inputSchema retourné par snowflake_list_tools
  - Outils Cortex typiques: CORTEX_AGENT_RUN, CORTEX_ANALYST_MESSAGE, CORTEX_SEARCH_SERVICE_QUERY, SYSTEM_EXECUTE_SQL
systemPromptInstructions.en:
- snowflake_call_tool: Invoke a tool on the Snowflake MCP server
  - Parameters: { name: string, arguments: object }
  - The name must match a tool returned by snowflake_list_tools
  - The arguments must match the inputSchema returned by snowflake_list_tools
  - Typical Cortex tools: CORTEX_AGENT_RUN, CORTEX_ANALYST_MESSAGE, CORTEX_SEARCH_SERVICE_QUERY, SYSTEM_EXECUTE_SQL
